author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

There has been a misunderstanding surrounding my ban. I wasn't meaning to offend him and I don't think I did very much. I didn't swear at him which shows that I've changed from before. We were both saying very similar things to eachother and it just got a bit heated. I am truly sorry for this and I know I can change what I did.

I hope you can accept this,

From DaCrowMan

title: My ban

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

After looking through the logs I have decided to deny this appeal. You were clearly abusing the other players involved, and you have received copious amounts of warnings. Abuse and harassment is not tolerated on Avicus, and I think you'll find that it's the same for every other community.

Regards,
Mango_
